summary: Frontend-only retest of the nested-scroll-container reset fix on PREVIEW (evidence-link-4.preview), logged in as admin@supervision.com via cookie injection (tests/get_tokens.py; admin now requires MFA so plain login returns requires_mfa). RESULT: (1) The original user-reported bug is FIXED - MeetingReport's #report-scroll-container resets to scrollTop=0 for ALL 6 tabs including Audit Trail, verified both by programmatic scroll and by REAL mouse-wheel scroll (Compliance scrolled to 3482 -> click Audit Trail -> scrollTop 0, 'Audit Trail' header rendered at top of viewport). Manual scrolling within a tab still works (scrollTop 400 persists). Route-level ScrollToTop spot check passed (app-scroll-container=0, window.scrollY=0 after navigating to /dashboard). (2) StaffPortfolio #evidence-scroll-container reset PASSES (3 meaningful switches with 176-232px prior scroll on Demo User's portfolio; container height temporarily forced to 120px in-test to make the small seeded evidence list scrollable). (3) BLOCKER: TeamInsights (/admin/team) now CRASHES to the route error boundary ('Something went wrong') with 'ReferenceError: matrixTab is not defined' - the new useEffect added at TeamInsights.js:1243-1245 lists matrixTab in its dependency array, but matrixTab state is declared at line 87 inside a DIFFERENT (child) component, not in the TeamInsights component. Test item #3 could not be executed at all; the whole Team Insights/Team Themes page is unusable. git diff confirms this is a regression introduced by this round's uncommitted change.

ui_bugs.issue: Page crashes on render: 'ReferenceError: matrixTab is not defined' thrown from the scroll-reset useEffect (line ~1243, deps [tab, matrixTab]). matrixTab/setMatrixTab are declared at line 87 inside the child matrix component, so the identifier is out of scope in TeamInsights -> RouteErrorBoundary shows 'Something went wrong'. Entire page unusable (regression from this round's fix).

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: TeamInsights.js - remove matrixTab from the useEffect deps in the TeamInsights component (keep [tab]) and add a separate useEffect on [matrixTab] INSIDE the child component that owns matrixTab (line ~87) doing document.getElementById('insights-scroll-container')?.scrollTo(0,0). Then rebuild and retest /admin/team.
Add an eslint no-undef / CI build lint gate: this crash is a plain undefined-variable error that shipped into the production bundle without failing the build.
After fixing, re-run test item #3 (main tabs matrix/themes/achievements/learning_needs/risks/actions + matrix sub-tabs cqc/care_cert/custom scroll reset).
critical_code_review_comments: TeamInsights.js:1243-1245 references matrixTab which is scoped to another component - undefined variable at runtime, crashes the page.

Seed data for portfolios is very thin (most users have 0 evidence items), so the evidence-tab scroll test is only meaningful for Demo User (831bdaef-...); consider seeding a portfolio with a long evidence list for future regression tests.

Audit Trail (both programmatic and real wheel scroll) - no need to re-verify unless the code changes. Note the report page needs ~6s to render (skeleton first) and an initial 401 on /api/auth/me is normal (axios retries with refresh cookie).
rca_of_the_issue: This round's fix added `useEffect(() => { document.getElementById('insights-scroll-container')?.scrollTo(0,0); }, [tab, matrixTab])` to the TeamInsights page component, but matrixTab is state of a separate child component (declared at TeamInsights.js:87). At render time the dependency array evaluates the free identifier matrixTab -> ReferenceError -> RouteErrorBoundary. Reproduce: log in as admin, open /admin/team; console shows 'ReferenceError: matrixTab is not defined at ct (assets/TeamInsights-*.js)'. Mitigation: scope the matrixTab reset effect to the child component that owns that state.
